limitations: OpenLigaDB is community-maintained and supplies results, kickoff, teams, league, round, and venue only.
No genuine immutable pre-kickoff odds were available; betting, ROI, CLV, and risk evidence are unavailable.
Lineups, injuries, suspensions, and match statistics are optional missing inputs.
Historical evaluation does not establish future predictive quality or profitability.

source_review.access_method: public HTTPS JSON API; explicit operator acquisition only
source_review.commercial_use_restrictions: ODbL permits use subject to attribution, share-alike, and keep-open obligations; production/commercial use requires separate legal review
source_review.competition_coverage: community-defined leagues; controlled pilot restricted to league shortcut bl1
source_review.historical_coverage: season endpoints; controlled pilot covers Bundesliga seasons 2018/19 through 2024/25
source_review.rate_limits: no explicit numerical limit identified in reviewed public documentation; acquisition is operator-triggered, sequential, bounded, and non-runtime
source_review.redistribution_restrictions: raw snapshots remain outside Git for this pilot; provenance, hashes, review, and attributed derived internal records may be retained; any public database redistribution requires ODbL review
source_review.reliability_assessment: useful for completed results and chronology but community-maintained; immutable hashes, strict normalization, exclusions, and independent provenance review remain mandatory
source_review.reviewer_operator_note: Approved only for controlled internal historical research with attribution. This is not production authorization, predictive validation, betting evidence, or publication permission.
source_review.robots_public_access_considerations: documented public API used directly; no HTML scraping, robots bypass, cookies, sessions, or anti-bot circumvention
source_review.terms_of_use_status: API data is published under the Open Database License (ODbL); attribution and share-alike obligations apply to redistributed databases
